defect_impact: A first-time user can submit an empty tenant key; the request fails, yet the key field is not marked invalid or linked to the correction. No operator/integration destination explains how to proceed.
owner_correction: SpendTerminalPage. Add explicit pre-submit tenant guidance, linked inline identity error, focus to the corrective field and an existing developer-reference link. Preserve memory-only masking, server authorization and the client API contract.

defect_impact: Typing an unsubmitted query produces “No matching providers.” Draft input is treated as completed evidence. There is no clear button. Source also lacks a request-generation guard, so stale-response behavior remains a risk to test.
owner_correction: Existing semantic-search controller and results region. Distinguish draft/submitted/loading/success/no-results/error; clear immediately; ignore superseded responses; keep explicit submit. Do not change the search API.

defect_impact: A recognized `/4663/share/:id` detail route never reaches the RH reader. It falls through to the Solana Radar landing/controller. Unknown signal slugs also silently fall through. Users lose the intended evidence journey.
owner_correction: Existing dispatcher and readers. Include the existing share reader in dispatch; provide an honest unknown-signal state using existing primitives and owning-family return links. No backend routes or share contract changes.

defect_impact: Research failure/missing-detail surfaces expose codes (`reflexive_pair_not_found`, `not_found`, raw API 404) or a generic degraded sentence without a local recovery action. A campaign error loses even its task heading.
owner_correction: RadarAsyncState, existing resource readers, RhChainRouteState/useApi/State. Use readable state-specific headings, non-issuing GET retry where supported, and owning-list navigation. Preserve partial evidence. Keep private 403/404 indistinguishable and never retry paid/mutation actions automatically.

route_evidence: `/spend-terminal`; [invalid input](evidence/05-budget-validation.jpg); browser observation recorded native “Value must be greater than or equal to 0.” `spendTerminalPage.tsx:36–50`.
owner_correction: Extend the existing form/label pattern with a shared field-feedback utility where reused. Use current schema constraints, `noValidate`, inline errors and first-invalid focus; retain inputs, values and duplicate-submit guard. This is a confirmed Premium mismatch; AT/WCAG adjudication is still needed.

defect_impact: Lifecycle stage name and status share an undelimited line: “JUDGMENT○ Missing evidence,” “EXECUTION○ Pending outcome.” Status becomes harder to scan, especially on mobile.
owner_correction: RadarReceiptLifecycle. Put title, status and detail on clearly separated lines inside the existing tile, using current spacing/type tokens. Keep all state mappings and missing-stage language.

defect_impact: Authenticated Execution/Evaluation provenance is effectively raw JSON. The loaded Execution contains a parent judgment ID but offers no parent-inspection link, timestamp summary or outcome explanation outside disclosure.
owner_correction: CanonicalReceiptPage plus existing evidence row/lifecycle. Present a compact summary of returned fields and explicit independently authenticated parent links. Never auto-load parents, carry keys in links/storage, mark absent stages complete or infer verification. Keep source disclosure.

owner_correction: SpendTerminalPage and current route catalog. Link to the exact existing dossier only for a confirmed catalog route; otherwise retain general route search with subject context. Display only server-supplied gaps/reasons; no invented evidence requirement, confidence or test-spend cap.

defect_impact: Route service/risk filters are lost on refresh; URL stays `/routes`. Filtered evidence review cannot be resumed or shared.
owner_correction: RoutesIndexPage. Restore committed filters/sort with safe URL state and back/forward behavior; validate against current catalog values. Preserve all cards, evidence and current local sort semantics.

defect_impact: `/developers` and the RH narrative alias have two h1s; `/solana` includes nested banner/contentinfo and duplicate skip navigation under the shared shell. The shell count test alone misses semantic duplication. Several missing states have no task h1.
owner_correction: Existing shell context and legacy route wrappers. Retain one task h1 and one global banner/contentinfo; render retained local controls/context with appropriate section semantics. Do not remove content or change its visual hierarchy without paired evidence. Multiple h1s alone are not an automatic WCAG failure.

defect_impact: Every legacy research destination crosses a 1.56MB raw research JS chunk and ~407KB raw CSS boundary. Current homepage remains light, but deep-route payload qualification is incomplete.

defect_impact: Both authenticated forms mask long manually entered keys but provide no deliberate show/hide control, making typo recovery difficult.
owner_correction: Existing credential fields. Reuse one small reveal control with accessible state/name, default masking, paste support and identical memory-only lifetime. No credential persistence, auto-provisioning or auth modification.
